headline: Ghana Outlines Plans for State-Owned Nuclear Power Plant
summary: Ghanaian Finance Minister Ato Forson announced government plans to establish a fully state-owned nuclear power plant to secure long-term industrial energy supply.
why: Expanding energy generation capacity is critical for industrial growth in West Africa's major economies.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Ghana announced long-term plans to construct a state-owned nuclear power plant.
